subject: Pilot starter pack and access asks
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@lumecorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-09T15:10:00Z
Subject: Pilot starter pack and access asks

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap + a compact starter pack to get the pilot moving. I pasted the high-level notes below and attached the POC_Starter_Pack.pdf and an access worksheet you can fill out with your infra contact.

Key pain / opportunity you reiterated:
- Customer support triage is slow: average response 6–8 hours, missed SLA incidents.
- High volume of repetitive queries (billing/refund, order status) that could be automated.
- Current latency and cost on third-party APIs makes experimentation expensive.

Pilot goals (30 days):
- Reduce tier-1 triage manual steps by ~40% (measured as # of handled tickets/week).
- Latency SLO: median < 120ms tail < 250ms for real-time assistant flows.
- Maintain precision on intent extraction > 92% on our eval prompt set.

Scope we recommend for MVP:
1) Ingest: sample of anonymized recent tickets (5k rows, CSV) for prompt/eval tuning.
2) Prompts: 25 prompt templates for triage, triage-to-resolution suggestions, and escalation.
3) Eval: gold set of 500 labeled tickets for quality regression checks.
4) Serving: hosted Redwood API initially, ramp to Dedicated in week 3 if throughput exceeds 120 req/s.

Success metrics & owners:
- Precision / Recall on intent extraction (owner: Samir / Luma data team)
- Tickets automated per week (owner: Marissa Cole, CS)
- Latency/cost per 1k tokens (owner: Marcus Lin, Infra/Eng)

Immediate access/setup asks (what we need from you):
- Provide a sample anonymized ticket CSV and the format schema (attach to this thread).
- Create a service account or API token for Redwood with access to the sample data (scoped read-only).
- Add procurement contact for contract/PO path (we'll loop legal as needed).
- Confirm whether PHI is present — if yes, flag so we enable private deployment option.

Timeline proposal:
- Week 0 (this week): data handoff + access; sign off on POC scope doc.
- Week 1: prompt set & eval creation; initial model selection; baseline metrics.
- Week 2: integrate sample dataset; run prompt tuning; start live A/B tests.
- Week 3–4: refine, run acceptance tests; decision point on Dedicated capacity.

Next steps (please):
1) Reply with confirmed kickoff date — we propose Tuesday 2027-11-16 09:00 PT for a 45m kickoff with Eng + CS + Data.
2) Share point-of-contact for procurement & legal (name + email).
3) Upload the sample ticket CSV or grant access to the Drive folder (link below).

Attachments: POC_Starter_Pack.pdf (scope + prompts + eval template), access-worksheet.csv
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPOCStarterPack

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Samir Patel <samir@lumecorp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@lumecorp.com>
Date: 2027-11-09T17:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot starter pack and access asks

Thanks, Kimberly — great summary and exactly the right focus. Quick answers below and a couple asks on our side.

1) We can share an anonymized sample (5k rows) by EOD tomorrow. Format: ticket_id, user_id_hash, created_at, category, body, resolution_status.
2) Service account: our infra team will create an AWS IAM role and short-lived token; I expect we can hand you a limited-scope S3 presigned URL and a service principal by Friday.
3) Procurement & legal: Elena Gomez (legal@lumecorp.com) and Rajesh Nair (procurement@lumecorp.com) are the contacts — looping them here.
4) PHI: there should be no PHI in the sample; I'll confirm with data governance before upload.

Two asks from Lumecorp:
- Can you provide a short SOC2 summary and our preferred data retention/ingestion controls? (we see the drive link but need a one-pager we can send to legal).
- Pricing: for a 30-day pilot with expected 200k tokens/day, please send a pilot SKU or indicative pricing that we can run by procurement.

I've attached the procurement SOW we typically use (lumecorp-procurement-sow.pdf) — it's a standard template.

Samir Patel
Head of Data Science | LumaCorp
samir@lumecorp.com
+1 (650) 555-0987
